name: getSOAPRequestHeader
description:
Obtains a SOAP request header. Call only from within
a CFC web service function that is processing a request
as a SOAP web service.
syntax: getSOAPRequestHeader( string namespace, string name, [boolean asXML] )

params.name: namespace
params.description: A String that is the namespace for the header.

params.name: name
params.description: A String that is the name of the header

params.name: asXML
params.description:
If True, the header is returned as a XML object;
if false (default), the header is returned as a Java object.
